name: mistral
description: Chat, code completion, embeddings, OCR, moderation, audio and batch jobs on Mistral AI models
long_description: Bring a Mistral AI API key from Mistral Studio; the gateway keeps it off your Sprite and sends it as a bearer token to the global endpoint api.mistral.ai. Saving, replacing or testing the key lists the models it can use (GET /v1/models), which uses no tokens. A Sprite can then run chat and fill-in-the-middle completions, create embeddings, run moderation and classifiers, run OCR on documents, transcribe and generate speech, upload and read files, and create, read and cancel batch jobs. Inference requests are billed to your Mistral account per token, page, minute or character. File and batch deletion, fine-tuning, model changes, agents, conversations, libraries and every admin endpoint (API keys, billing, users, workspaces) are not forwarded.

presentation.tagline: Call Mistral AI models for chat, code, embeddings, OCR and audio from a Sprite without putting your key on it.
presentation.setup: In Mistral Studio open API Keys (console.mistral.ai/api-keys), select New key, set an expiration date and copy the key; it is shown only once. API access needs billing activated on your organization.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving or testing the key reads `GET /v1/models`, which uses no tokens. Chat, fill-in-the-middle and embeddings are billed per input and output token at the model's price, OCR per 1,000 pages, transcription per audio minute and speech generation per character. Mistral Moderation is free on the moderation and classification routes; a classification with another model is billed at that model's price. Batch jobs are billed at half the standard price. Requests draw on your organization's included usage, then prepaid credits with pay-as-you-go; Mistral answers 402 when credits run out or a spending limit is reached.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Only `GET /v1/models`, `GET /v1/models/:model_id`, `POST /v1/chat/completions`, `POST /v1/fim/completions`, `POST /v1/embeddings`, `POST /v1/moderations`, `POST /v1/chat/moderations`, `POST /v1/classifications`, `POST /v1/chat/classifications`, `POST /v1/ocr`, `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions`, `POST /v1/audio/speech`, `GET` and `POST /v1/files`, `GET /v1/files/:file_id` with its `/content` and `/url`, `GET` and `POST /v1/batch/jobs`, `GET /v1/batch/jobs/:job_id` and `POST /v1/batch/jobs/:job_id/cancel` are forwarded. File and batch deletion, fine-tuning, model updates and deletion, agents, conversations, libraries and the admin API (keys, billing, users, workspaces, audit logs) are not.

notices.title: Global endpoint only
notices.body: Requests go to `api.mistral.ai`, where Mistral does not commit to an inference location. The EU (`api.eu.mistral.ai`) and US (`api.us.mistral.ai`) regional endpoints are not covered by this connector.

usage_notes: The gateway waits 120 seconds for response headers. Mistral has no request timeout parameter, so stream long chat completions with `"stream": true`, keep `max_tokens` and OCR `pages` small, or use a batch job for large work.

`POST /v1/files` and `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions` take a multipart body (`curl -F file=@doc.pdf -F purpose=ocr`); a transcription can name a `file_url` or an uploaded `file_id` instead of sending the audio. Keep uploads within the gateway's request body limit.
Error bodies are `{"object": "error", "message", "type", "code"}` with a four-digit `code`; a bad key is 401 `{"detail": "Invalid API Key"}` and a 422 lists invalid fields under `detail`.
